Release readiness, source-bound evidence, distribution, state consistency, security, lockfile, Japanese capability, and strict quality checks pass for the exact candidate source.

guidelines: Every factual human-facing stop, resolution, risk, verification, and benefit claim must carry evidenceRefs.
Unsupported benefit language is inference, never a fact; do not use self-praise or unquantified performance claims.
Historical archives are immutable and may only be read and referenced.
Release publication is fail-closed on missing, stale, mismatched, or provider-unverified evidence.
Human Outcome language follows the conversation language: English for this Work Item.
The user-authorized acceptance of the immutable WI-24 warning is recorded as a human decision, not as a claim that the warning was removed.

constraints: Do not rewrite historical archives or reuse stale rehearsal/provider evidence.
Publish only after exact-source rehearsal, provider verification, and tagged Quick Install pass.
Preserve unrelated dirty worktrees and recovery branches.
